name: crm
description: Small sales CRM: contacts and companies deduplicated by email, pipeline stages with probabilities, activity reminders, CSV import folder and a monthly forecast.
author: test3 author B

issues.description: Contacts added without tags all share the default list object, so tagging one contact tags every contact created without tags, across books.
issues.fix_hint: Default tags to None and give each new contact its own list.

issues.description: The docstring and README say duplicates are detected regardless of letter case, but the key only strips whitespace, so Ann@Example.com and ann@example.com become two contacts.
issues.fix_hint: Lower-case the stripped address (strip().lower() or casefold()).

issues.description: StageChange takes from_stage then to_stage, but move passes the new stage first, so the history is backwards and entered_stage_at finds the wrong moves.
issues.fix_hint: Pass previous as from_stage and stage as to_stage.

issues.description: The uploaded file name is joined to the import folder unchecked, so a name like ../../x writes anywhere the process can write.
issues.fix_hint: Resolve the target and reject names that leave the import folder, or keep only the base name.

issues.description: The forecast keeps its own copy of the stage win probabilities instead of using pipeline.STAGE_PROBABILITY and weighted_amount, so changing a stage's probability in the pipeline leaves the forecast stale.

issues.anchor: def import_contacts(self, path: Path, book: ContactBook) -> ImportResult:
issues.description: One function checks the header, validates rows, creates companies, parses tags, cleans phone numbers, merges contacts and logs; the per-row steps belong in helpers.
The private helper is never called anywhere in the package.

decoys.why_it_is_fine: The broad except only logs with the traceback and re-raises, so no error is swallowed.

decoys.anchor: current = datetime.now() if now is None else now
decoys.why_it_is_fine: The default is None and the current time is read on each call, not once when the function is defined.
